zone.name: Summits & Icefields 2 descents
zone.description: Descents from Summits & Icefields 2. Grid references are UTM zone 11.

routes.name: Battleship NW slope
routes.description: The large northwest-facing slope below The Battleship (488200 E 5511800 ) and The Giant's Kneecap (488700 E 5511400 N) down toward the Slocan Chief Cabin gives an excellent run of about 600 vertical metres.

routes.name: Esmeralda to Joker Lakes
routes.description: One of the finest runs is to ski north from the summit of Esmeralda or Cond peak down Kokanee Glacier to an unnamed lake (489700 E 5512400 N), then farther down to Joker Lakes (490100 E 5513300 N).This is a long run, about 800 vertical metres.

routes.name: Outlook Mountain north summit
routes.description: Another good run can be had from the north summit of Outlook Mountain (486200 E 5509800 N). Head north, then curve down to the right to reach Kokanee Pass (s50 vertical metres). The approach to this peak is up Outlook Creek to Lemon Pass, where the way above is blocked by a short steep section. It is possible to ascend the obstacle by a narrow crest just above Lemon Pass (485100 E 55113°0 N).
routes.notes: Guide note: si3 'north summit of Outlook Mountain (486200 E 5509800 N)' coincides with today's Mount John Carter (ATES landmark within ~60 m). 's50 vertical metres' is a typo (likely 550 or 650). '55113°0' = 5511300; '55II300' = 5511300.

routes.name: Nansen and Giegerich crests
routes.description: Good runs of about 250 vertical metres can be found from the crests of Nansen Mountain and Mount Giegerich into the basin of Griffith Creek.

routes.name: Smuggler's Ridge west flank
routes.description: If the weather is overcast, a good location for skiing with a few trees to enhance visibility is along the west flank of Smuggler's Ridge and, near the bottom, below the ridge toward Slocan Chief Cabin. Smuggler's Ridge is the crest which descends northwest from The Pyramids (488200 E 55II300 N) to about 486600 E 5512600 .

routes.name: Summit ski options
routes.description: Many summits can be reached at Kokanee Glacier Park. It is possible to ski to the top of the Pyramids, Esmeralda Peak, Cond Peak and Kokanee Peak. You can walk out onto the crest of The Battleship, but reaching the summit of The Giant's Kneecap involves some technical climbing and requires a rope.
